text: function calculates last frost day numeric vector daily minimum temperatures using tidyverse principles.

title: Calculate the last frost day — last_frost_day
Calculate the last frost day — last_frost_day
text: .data data frame tibble containing daily minimum temperatures column named "mint". threshold stress temperature threshold frost (default: 0) hemisphere Hemisphere indicator: "south" "north" (default: "south"). latitude information available data, used determine hemisphere. require_full_year Logical. TRUE, requires exactly 365 366 days (default: TRUE)

title: Calculate the last frost day — last_frost_day
text: data.frame tibble representing day year last frost, NA frost occurs

title: Calculate the last frost day — last_frost_day
code: file <- system.file("extdata/ppd_72150.met", package = "tidyweather") records <- read_weather(file) records |>     dplyr::group_by(year) |>      last_frost_day(require_full_year = FALSE) #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #> # Groups:   year [3] #>    year last_frost_day #>   <dbl>          <dbl> #> 1  2023             NA #> 2  2024            262 #> 3  2025            183
